clips.title: The story
paras: Putrid Claws reach Deathguard Dillinger as proof that the Scourge near Brill is being held back. Mindless undead roam the woods west of town, especially by the old bridge.

The mindless Scourge keeps crossing into Tirisfal Glades. Rotting dead and ravaged corpses wander the eastern borders, gathering along roads and near the old bridge west of Brill. Deathguards place bounties on these horrors to protect travelers and garrison supply lines. A severed putrid claw proves that one more shambling corpse has been put down for good.
